title: Jev series copy edit: measurement wording for confidence, no full-coverage claims
description: Limatus flags 'honest' used as a character trait for a measurement in the Jev series: plexus-classifier-lab, can-you-trust-jev-confidence (3), distilling-jev-into-a-classifier (2), jev-vs-laya (2). Rewrite each to name the measurement (calibrated, matches observed accuracy). Two sentences also imply a QA operation reviews every call (jev-vs-laya auto-accept paragraph, can-you-trust step 4); reword to 'far more calls than a sampled audit' since full coverage is not a claim we make. Every number stays. Content repo PR into main, then pin PR into develop. Rescan with Limatus after.
